# TractableBayesianInference

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Tractable Bayesian inference ensures that probabilistic queries on fused Bayesian networks remain computationally feasible. It directly addresses the real-time and energy limitations of in-network neuromorphic and topology-centric computing.
